{{Quote|Affirmative. This is Firebase Alpha. We read you, ''Falcon.'' How was your trip?|A [[Unidentified Rebel (Firebase Alpha)|Rebel]] to Han Solo|<ref name="Maze Run">{{InsiderCite|131|Maze Run}}</ref>}}
'''Firebase Alpha''' was an energy-[[mining]] station on a remote [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] located 1.5 terameters from a [[Black hole/Legends|black hole]] inside the [[Rishi Maze/Legends|Rishi Maze]] satellite dwarf [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. Firebase Alpha was operated by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. 

==History==
Sometime before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the station was in desperate need of supplies. The [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and his [[Pilot/Legends|co-pilot]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] were contracted to bring those supplies to the base. The two successfully navigated past an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] blockade and through the Rishi Maze in their [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]. The route they were given took them past a [[Unidentified Sith battlecruiser|long-dead Sith warship]], which sent attack drones after them. After disabling the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] vessel, Solo contacted Firebase Alpha for landing clearance. As he approached, Chewbacca detected an energy signature in the cargo hold. Solo investigated and discovered that it was an Imperial [[Baradium/Legends|baradium]] bomb intended to destroy the Rebel Alliance station. Solo was able to eject the bomb into space, where it harmlessly exploded.

==Behind the scenes==
Firebase Alpha appears in ''[[Maze Run]]'', a short story published in the [[January]] [[2012]] magazine [[Star Wars Insider 131|''Star Wars Insider'' 131]].
